snippet.title: Renewed History Content Creator Pack | Trailer | Cities: Skylines
snippet.description:
Renewed History will be available on the 10th of March!

Balance old with new with Brum's newest Creator Pack, Renewed History!

If you're looking to preserve the historical look of your city, but also fancy the idea of a touch of contemporary architecture, this pack was made for you!

Get Renewed History here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4031140/Cities_Skylines__Content_Creator_Pack_Renewed_History/
